guarantees.claim: unused_cfg_qe is the XOR reduction of the qe bits from the 7 specified config register fields.
sha_en is directly driven by the q output of register sha_en.
hmac_en is directly driven by the q output of register hmac_en.
digest_size_supplied is the raw value of cfg_reg.digest_size.q re-cast to the digest_mode_e enum type.

uncertain_points.claim: Signal unused_cfg_qe drives an XOR reduction of multiple configuration QE bits, but its usage is not visible in this chunk; it may be permanently dead or unconnected.
uncertain_points.risk: If the signal is not connected, any configuration integrity checking that depends on QE bits is missing, allowing silent corruption of critical config fields.

uncertain_points.claim: digest_size_supplied is formed by casting cfg_reg.digest_size.q to digest_mode_e without verifying the raw value is a legal enum encoding.
uncertain_points.cond: when cfg_reg.digest_size.q holds a value not defined in digest_mode_e
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream logic that uses digest_size_supplied may behave incorrectly, potentially using wrong digest length or accessing incorrect data, leading to functional or security failures.
